command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_thermal.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: On a unit contact edge use y=s-1/2, linear area-scaled conductance 2+2y and peak temperature-jump phasor y+i*b for b=0,0.25,1. Per-direction energy in a zero-mean cycle is (2/omega) times the integral of (2+2y)*sqrt(y²+b²). Compare a closed antiderivative on full, clipped and zero-width segments, with a common phase rotation and zero field control. omega=2.5 rad/s; default order 16 Gauss-Legendre on each side of the minimum amplitude.
